model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в съотношението на разредеността (sparsity ratio) на изхода на SDPA по слоеве на модела при два различни прага, представени в две отделни графики, разположени една до друга.

И двете графики споделят еднаква структура на осите. Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" и представя номера на слоя с линейна скала, като стойностите варират от 0 до приблизително 22, с етикети през интервал от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Sparsity Ratio" и също използва линейна скала, като в лявата графика диапазонът е от 0.0 до 1.0 с етикети през 0.2, а в дясната графика диапазонът е от 0.0 до приблизително 0.8 с етикети през 0.2. И двете графики съдържат по три линии, обозначени в легендата.

В лявата графика, озаглавена „Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2", са представени три линии. Първата линия е синя, с плътен стил, обозначена като „sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03". Тя остава близо до 0.0 по цялата дължина на оста X, без видими върхове или значителни промени. Втората линия е оранжева, с пунктиран стил, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44". Тя започва при слой 0 с висока стойност от приблизително 1.0, след което рязко спада до около 0.2 при слой 5, продължава да намалява плавно и достига стойности близо до 0.05–0.1 при слоевете след 10, като остава ниска до слой 22. Третата линия е зелена, с пунктиран стил с точки, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". Тя следва подобна тенденция на оранжевата линия, като започва от приблизително 0.9 при слой 0, спада рязко до около 0.15 при слой 5 и остава на ниски стойности близо до 0.05 за останалите слоеве.

В дясната графика, озаглавена „Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3", също са представени три линии. Първата линия е синя, с плътен стил, обозначена като „sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003". Тя остава практически на нулево ниво по цялата ос X. Втората линия е оранжева, с пунктиран стил, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126". Тя започва при слой 0 с висока стойност от приблизително 0.8, след което рязко спада до около 0.1 при слой 5 и продължава да намалява до стойности близо до 0.0 за слоевете след 10. Третата линия е зелена, с пунктиран стил с точки, обозначена като „sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080". Тя следва подобна тенденция, като започва от приблизително 0.6 при слой 0, спада до около 0.05 при слой 5 и остава на много ниски стойности за останалите слоеве.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The figure consists of two line charts that share the same axis structure, showing the proportion of SDPA output values below a specified threshold after gating, with the left panel using a threshold of 1e-2 and the right panel using a threshold of 1e-3. Both charts have an x-axis labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Both charts have a y-axis labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2.

In the left panel (Threshold 1e-2), three lines are plotted. The first line, shown in blue with a solid style, represents the sparsity ratio before gating (average 0.03); it remains near 0.0 across all layers with minimal variation. The second line, shown in green with a dashed style, represents the sparsity ratio after gating (average 0.44); it starts at approximately 1.0 at layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.4 by layer 5, continues declining to roughly 0.1 near layer 10, then remains relatively low through layer 20, with a slight uptick near the final layers. The third line, shown in orange with a dotted style, represents the sparsity ratio after average gating (average 0.33); it follows a similar trajectory to the green line but at slightly lower values, starting near 0.9 at layer 0, declining to approximately 0.3 by layer 5, and settling around 0.05–0.1 for the remaining layers.

In the right panel (Threshold 1e-3), three lines are again plotted. The first line, in blue with a solid style, represents the sparsity ratio before gating (average 0.003); it stays very close to 0.0 across all layers. The second line, in green with a dashed style, represents the sparsity ratio after gating (average 0.126); it begins at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, drops steeply to around 0.1 by layer 5, and then remains near 0.0 through layer 20 with only minor fluctuations. The third line, in orange with a dotted style, represents the sparsity ratio after average gating (average 0.080); it starts at approximately 0.6 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.05 by layer 5, and stays near 0.0 for the remaining layers, closely tracking the green line in the later layers.
model_annotations.English:
This figure contains two side-by-side line plots illustrating the proportion of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output values below a specified threshold after gating, across network layers. Both plots share the same axis structure.

**Left plot (Threshold 1e-2):** The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. Three lines are shown. The first line, depicted in blue and labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," remains very low and nearly flat across all layers, staying close to 0.0 throughout. The second line, shown in green (dashed) and labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," starts high at approximately 1.0 at layer 0, drops steeply to around 0.2 by layer 5, then continues to decline gradually, reaching approximately 0.05–0.1 by layer 22. The third line, depicted in orange (dashed) and labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," follows a similar pattern to the green line but at somewhat lower values, starting near 0.8 at layer 0, declining to approximately 0.15 by layer 5, and settling near 0.05 by layer 22.

**Right plot (Threshold 1e-3):** The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to approximately 0.8. Three lines are shown. The first line, in blue and labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003," remains essentially flat near 0.0 across all layers. The second line, in green (dashed) and labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126," starts at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.05 by layer 5, and remains near 0.0 for the remaining layers. The third line, in orange (dashed) and labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080," starts at approximately 0.5 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.05 by layer 5, and remains near 0.0 thereafter.
model_annotations.German:
Dieses Diagrammpaar zeigt den Anteil der SDPA-Ausgabewerte (Scaled Dot-Product Attention), die unterhalb eines bestimmten Schwellenwerts liegen, über die Schichten eines Netzwerks hinweg, wobei das linke Diagramm den Schwellenwert 1e-2 und das rechte Diagramm den Schwellenwert 1e-3 verwendet. Beide Diagramme teilen dieselbe Achsenstruktur: Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis etwa 22, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 5, 10, 15 und 20. Die y-Achse ist mit „Sparsity Ratio" beschriftet, linear skaliert und reicht von 0.0 bis 1.0 im linken Diagramm bzw. von 0.0 bis etwa 0.8 im rechten Diagramm, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Schritten von 0.2.

Im linken Diagramm (Schwellenwert 1e-2) sind drei Linien dargestellt. Die blaue durchgezogene Linie mit Kreismarkierungen repräsentiert das Sparsity-Verhältnis vor dem Gating mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.03; sie verläuft nahezu konstant bei niedrigen Werten nahe 0.0 über alle Schichten hinweg. Die grüne gestrichelte Linie mit Dreiecksmarkierungen zeigt das Sparsity-Verhältnis nach dem Gating mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.44; sie beginnt bei etwa 1.0 in Schicht 0, fällt steil ab auf etwa 0.4 bei Schicht 5, sinkt weiter auf etwa 0.2 bei Schicht 10 und verbleibt dann auf niedrigem Niveau zwischen 0.1 und 0.2 für die restlichen Schichten. Die orange gepunktete Linie mit Quadratmarkierungen zeigt das Sparsity-Verhältnis nach durchschnittlichem Gating mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.33; sie beginnt bei etwa 0.9 in Schicht 0, fällt auf etwa 0.3 bei Schicht 5 und stabilisiert sich dann bei Werten zwischen 0.1 und 0.2 für die tieferen Schichten, wobei sie einen ähnlichen, aber leicht niedrigeren Verlauf als die grüne Linie aufweist.

Im rechten Diagramm (Schwellenwert 1e-3) sind ebenfalls drei Linien dargestellt. Die blaue durchgezogene Linie mit Kreismarkierungen repräsentiert das Sparsity-Verhältnis vor dem Gating mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.003; sie verläuft nahezu konstant bei Werten nahe 0.0 über alle Schichten. Die grüne gestrichelte Linie mit Dreiecksmarkierungen zeigt das Sparsity-Verhältnis nach dem Gating mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.126; sie beginnt bei etwa 0.8 in Schicht 0, fällt steil auf etwa 0.1 bei Schicht 5 und verbleibt dann auf niedrigem Niveau nahe 0.0 bis 0.05 für die restlichen Schichten. Die orange gepunktete Linie mit Quadratmarkierungen zeigt das Sparsity-Verhältnis nach durchschnittlichem Gating mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.080; sie beginnt bei etwa 0.6 in Schicht 0, fällt auf etwa 0.05 bei Schicht 5 und verbleibt dann auf sehr niedrigem Niveau nahe 0.0 für die tieferen Schichten.
